summary: LocalSetup 4.44.1 corrects the active release sequence to the authorized 4.x line and combines the approved GitHub visual identity, canonical repository spelling, and a safe installer fallback for mixed-major release tags. The published v5.6.2 tag and assets remain unchanged.

highlights.text: **Corrected 4.x release line:** The verified history maps v5.6.2 content to corrected arithmetic 4.43.2, the branding feature to 4.44.0, and canonical repository-name policy to 4.44.1. The policy blocks MAJOR increments while the 4.x lock is active.

**Theme-aware LocalSetup graphics:** The README hero, architecture diagram, and install-flow diagram use matching light and dark artwork with the approved mark, palette, and typography. The pinned renderer, JetBrains Mono files, source tokens, and font license make the exports reproducible.

**Canonical name and release discovery:** Public repository policy uses `LocalSetup` spelling while retaining established commands and URLs. If release API lookup fails and stable tags span multiple major versions, the installer asks for `LOCALSETUP_BOOTSTRAP_REF` instead of guessing from numeric order.

compatibility: The v5.6.2 and v4.22.9 published tags and release assets are preserved. No v5.7.0 or v5.7.1 release tag or download was published; those draft records are superseded by this corrected release line.

The SDK `read_file` paging contract and Agent Q registry-v2/signed-envelope changes introduced in v5.6.2 remain in effect. Correcting the version number does not restore compatibility; integrations must follow the v5.6.2 migration guidance.
The framework command and Python distribution remain `localsetup`; the integrated CLI remains `lscli`. Existing repository URL paths, adapter identifiers, and installation paths remain compatible.

When GitHub release API lookup is unavailable, same-major stable-tag fallback remains available. Mixed-major tag sets require an explicit `LOCALSETUP_BOOTSTRAP_REF`; a clean existing managed source can still be reused under the documented installer behavior.
update: Update a registered installation using the [quickstart instructions](https://github.com/CruxExperts/localsetup/blob/v4.44.1/ls/docs/QUICKSTART.md#update).

For managed bootstrap, set `LOCALSETUP_BOOTSTRAP_REF` only when you intentionally want a specific branch, tag, or commit. See the [multi-platform installation guide](https://github.com/CruxExperts/localsetup/blob/v4.44.1/ls/docs/MULTI_PLATFORM_INSTALL.md).

Use the [branding guide](https://github.com/CruxExperts/localsetup/blob/v4.44.1/ls/docs/BRANDING.md) and pinned renderer to maintain the README graphics. AstroSite remains a separate project that should follow the documented visual contract.
verification: Download `localsetup-v4.44.1.tar.gz`, its `.sha256` checksum, and `.cdx.json` SBOM sidecar together. Follow the [release guide verification steps](https://github.com/CruxExperts/localsetup/blob/v4.44.1/ls/docs/releases/4.44.1.md#verify-the-download) and run `verify-release` against the archive; confirm that the signed `v4.44.1` tag points to the published release commit.

Before release, verify all six documentation graphics against the pinned renderer, font hashes and license; inspect both GitHub color themes; validate release notes and generated-doc receipts; and run the focused branding, installer, versioning, and documentation tests plus the full Python suite.
The 4.x release lock permits MINOR and PATCH increments only. Version-plan must show v4.44.1 for this release and reject any prospective MAJOR classification while the lock remains active.
